description: Frontend Snip Tool UI for M2 task 2.5 (+ 2.6 UI): extend the single typed engineClient with recognizeSnip/getHardware/setDevice/modelStatus/modelDownload wrappers + subscribeSnipCaptured/subscribeModelProgress + the shared TS types mirroring the engine Pydantic models (it stays the ONLY invoke/listen importer and makes NO fetch); add the snip.*/hardware.* i18n keys with id/en parity (+ a parity test); build SnipPopup (LaTeX + real-KaTeX preview + confidence/validation badge with a 'confidence unavailable' state + LaTeX/MathML/Markdown copy, keyboard-first/ARIA, needs_review/failed review state never fabricated) and the Settings hardware section. Satisfies task 2.5 done to the closest runnable approximation (hotkey->select->LaTeX shown; copy works), with live hotkey/capture/popup documented pending manual. Design: m2-design.md §B.11, §B.2a/§B.2b, §B.9. Depends on FEAT-004.
steps: Read .agents/tasks/context.json + FEAT-004.findings + this file FIRST, then m2-design.md §B.11/§B.2a/§B.2b/§B.9. Mirror the engine Pydantic models + the Rust command/event names FEAT-003/FEAT-004 recorded exactly.

Add frontend deps if not already present (katex@0.16.11 may have been added in FEAT-002 for the allow-list generator; @tauri-apps/plugin-global-shortcut 2.x): apps/desktop/package.json + pnpm-lock.yaml + docs/LICENSES.md rows (katex MIT; plugin Apache-2.0 OR MIT). Verify exact versions on npm.

Extend engineClient.ts (design §B.11) — it stays the ONLY module importing invoke/listen and makes NO fetch. Add recognizeSnip(pngBase64, isDisplay), getHardware(), setDevice(device), modelStatus(id), modelDownload(id) as invoke wrappers and subscribeSnipCaptured(cb), subscribeModelProgress(cb) as listen wrappers. Add shared TS types mirroring the engine models exactly: RecognitionStatus ('ok'|'needs_review'|'failed'), SnipResult, Hardware/Device, confidenceKind, ModelProgress/ModelFileProgress/ModelDownloadState (§B.2b, camelCase).

Add the M2 i18n keys with id/en parity (design §B.11): add exactly the snip.* and hardware.* keys enumerated in §B.11 (NO snip.copyOmml — OMML is M6) to BOTH locales/id.json (default) and locales/en.json. Add locales.test.ts asserting the recursively-flattened key sets of id.json and en.json are identical.

Build SnipPopup.tsx (design §B.11): read-only LaTeX box; live KaTeX preview (the authoritative render); confidence/validation badge colored by ok|needs_review|failed, rendering 'confidence unavailable' when confidenceKind === 'unavailable'; LaTeX/MathML/Markdown copy buttons (Markdown wraps $$...$$ / $...$ by isDisplay) via the Tauri clipboard routed through engineClient; keyboard-first (Esc close, Enter copy LaTeX, focus trap, ARIA live region); a needs_review/failed result renders a clear 'could not recognize' state, never fabricated LaTeX. Wire capture->recognize via subscribeSnipCaptured -> recognizeSnip. All strings via i18next; all engine calls via engineClient.

Build SettingsHardware.tsx (design §B.11): render getHardware() + a device <select> calling setDevice + the 'CPU mode is slower' note (R-HW-2) as an i18next string. Mount SnipPopup + the hardware section into App.tsx.

Write vitest tests (bridge mocked): engineClient.test.ts (each new wrapper invokes the right command / listens on the right event; a grep-style assertion that engineClient.ts is the sole production importer of invoke/listen and uses no fetch — as in M1); SnipPopup.test.tsx (renders LaTeX + copy buttons from i18next; the needs_review review state; the 'confidence unavailable' rendering); SettingsHardware.test.tsx (renders devices + override calls setDevice); katexRender.test.ts (the REAL pinned katex renderToString over the fixture + golden LaTeX — no ParseError on valid, ParseError on invalid — AC-5 UI side); locales.test.ts (id/en parity).

Run the frontend gate: pnpm --filter desktop lint ; pnpm --filter desktop test -- --run ; pnpm --filter desktop build. Append output to docs/m2-verification.md; document the live hotkey/region-capture/on-screen popup as host/interactive PENDING manual (never claimed passed). Commit locally (conventional-commit), NEVER push. Set status completed; note in findings any UI state the merge/finalize step should surface.
acceptance_criteria: engineClient gains recognizeSnip/getHardware/setDevice/modelStatus/modelDownload + subscribeSnipCaptured/subscribeModelProgress as invoke/listen wrappers; it remains the ONLY production module importing invoke/listen and makes NO fetch (grep-confirmed); the shared TS types mirror the engine models incl. the RecognitionStatus union and the ModelProgress mirror (engineClient.test.ts — AC-8 client side).

The Snip popup renders LaTeX + a real-KaTeX preview + LaTeX/MathML/Markdown copy buttons from i18next strings, shows 'confidence unavailable' for the unavailable branch, and renders the needs_review/failed state without fabricated LaTeX (SnipPopup.test.tsx).
A vitest test renders the fixture + golden LaTeX with the real pinned katex and asserts no ParseError on valid cases and a ParseError on invalid ones (katexRender.test.ts — AC-5 UI side).
locales/id.json and locales/en.json have identical flattened key sets incl. the snip.*/hardware.* keys (locales.test.ts — R-UI-10).
docs/LICENSES.md has rows for katex + @tauri-apps/plugin-global-shortcut in the same change (AC-9).
verification: From the worktree root with the PATH export: pnpm --filter desktop lint ; pnpm --filter desktop test -- --run ; pnpm --filter desktop build — all green. Live hotkey/region-capture/on-screen popup are host/interactive and documented pending manual, not asserted.
